subject: Request: price variance approval for HelioHealth strategic package
messages:
From: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@heliohealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelioHealth commercial proposal — ask on structure and final price

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the ROI modeling you shared. We have a hard internal target for procurement to stay within a $215k ARR ceiling for year one.

Below is the consolidated ask from our buyers:
- 12-month term, 1.2M tokens/mo average consumption estimate
- Desire: dedicated capacity option + SOC2 evidence in contract
- Commercial ask: effective first-year rate not to exceed $215k ARR (includes onboarding credits)

Jordan indicated there may be flexibility on packaging (mix of hosted vs dedicated) to get to their number — can you confirm whether a one-time onboarding credit + 10% first-year discount would be feasible, and whether any packaging swaps (move some seats to shared host) could lower the unit rate?

I’m attaching our internal forecast for reference (Attachment: helio_forecast_q4.xlsx). Procurement needs a clear memo for exec approval by EOB Mon. Can you share your recommended structure and whether you need VP/CFO signoff for this concession?

Appreciate it —
Sara
Commercial Programs | HelioHealth

---
Attachment: helio_forecast_q4.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: HelioHealth commercial proposal — ask on structure and final price

Jordan/Kim,

Forwarding Helio’s email — they have a hard $215k ARR ceiling for Y1. Quick summary of options I modeled:

Option A (hosted-heavy): 12-month, hosted + 2x support seats, 15% discount + $20k onboarding credit => ~$232k ARR (too high)
Option B (hybrid): Dedicated pool for peak + hosted fallback, 10% discount + $25k onboarding credit + 6-month usage smoothing => ~$212k ARR (meets target)
Option C (aggressive credit): Dedicated + 20% discount + $35k onboarding credit but reduces margin materially (~35% margin hit)

I attached my working pricing model (helio_pricing_model_v3.xlsx) and a short internal memo outlining why Option B is our recommended path (keeps margin footprint reasonable and preserves the dedicated sale).

Question for you both: does Option B require VP/CFO exception for the onboarding credit + 10% (we may be outside standard guardrails on onboarding credit size for a first-year commitment)? If so, can we get a brief signoff memo we can send to their procurement?

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: helio_pricing_model_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 56KB)
Attachment: internal-variance-memo.pdf (pdf, 72KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: HelioHealth commercial proposal — ask on structure and final price

Olga/Jordan —

I reviewed the attachment and the P&L sensitivity. Two quick notes:
1) The $25k onboarding credit in Option B is technically above our standard cap for this segment; approval needed.
2) The dedicated pool sizing looks conservative — recommend we add a 10% burst buffer but ensure contract language allows autoscaling to hosted for bursts. That will keep costs predictable.

If we proceed with Option B (10% discount + $25k onboarding credit), we should require a stricter usage ramp clause (3-month review) and a cap on peak Q1 token consumption to protect margin. Also request Jordan to confirm internal net-new ARR attribution.

I’m looping Ben for CF/legal visibility on the credit and to ask if a VP/CFO memo is required for this level of onboarding concession.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

---
(Quoted from Olga Petrov)
> Option B (hybrid): Dedicated pool for peak + hosted fallback, 10% discount + $25k onboarding credit + 6-month usage smoothing => ~$212k ARR (meets target)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — HelioHealth strategic pilot (Option B recommended)

Marissa/Ben —

Requesting quick exec approval for a one-time variance on onboarding credits and a packaged discount for HelioHealth (deal HLH-2026-017). Summary:
- Customer: HelioHealth (healthtech prospect)
- Term: 12 months; recommended packaging: hybrid dedicated + hosted fallback
- Proposed commercial terms (Option B): 10% first-year discount, $25k onboarding credit, 12-month commit => projected first-year revenue $212k ARR
- Rationale: preserves dedicated sale (strategic reference), meets buyer procurement ceiling, reduces chance of losing to competitor with lower hosted-only pricing
- Guardrails requested: 3-month usage review, peak Q1 cap, automatic rollback to standard rates if breach in ramp clause

Attachments: internal-variance-memo.pdf (internal summary + margin impact), helio_pricing_model_v3.xlsx (detailed model). We need a short signoff (email ok) to pass to Helio procurement by COB Mon.

If you want smaller onboarding credit (e.g., $15k) we can revisit pricing to maintain margin, but that likely pushes ARR above their $215k ceiling.

Best,
Olga
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: internal-variance-memo.pdf (pdf, 72KB)
Attachment: helio_pricing_model_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 56KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — HelioHealth strategic pilot (Option B recommended)

Olga/Marissa —

Thanks for the clear brief and the model. I reviewed the margin impact and the proposed guardrails. Approve Option B with the following conditions:
1) Onboarding credit capped at $25k (as proposed) and paid over the first invoice (not refundable).
2) Usage ramp clause with defined checkpoints at 30/90/180 days; escalation to Commercial Ops if >25% over forecast at any checkpoint.
3) Legal to add the autoscale-to-hosted fallback clause with a defined rate table to avoid unexpected overages.

Marissa — please coordinate a short note we can share with Helio procurement confirming the variance and the conditions above. Olga/Jordan — once I have that note (and Legal has the clause) you can execute.

Ben Carter
Chief Financial Officer
Redwood Inference

(Approved 2026-10-05 11:30 PDT)
